caption: The drawing depicts a single round object positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The object is a circular shield with a raised, symmetrical floral or geometric design in relief, consisting of rounded, overlapping shapes radiating from the center. The shield is colored in earthy tones, predominantly shades of brown, red, and green, which blend together to create a patinated appearance. There is a small protrusion on the left side of the shield, possibly a handle or attachment. The drawing is signed "Harry Main Waddell" in small letters near the bottom right corner of the paper. No other objects or patterns are present on the page.
